jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Senior Implementation Manager serves as a senior member of the Implementation Team and is responsible for leading the organization's most complex, strategic, and high-visibility client implementations. This role serves as the primary client-facing partner throughout implementation and provides leadership through execution, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and operational readiness. The Senior Implementation Manager partners closely with Product, Implementation Consultants, Implementation Analysts, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, Account Management, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful implementation outcomes. While this role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to mentor team members, drive implementation best practices, and serve as an escalation point for complex delivery challenges. The Senior Implementation Manager facilitates implementation planning, monitors progress against agreed-upon milestones, identifies risks and dependencies, and drives cross-functional coordination to support successful client launches.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary implementation lead for the organization's largest, most complex, and highest-profile client programs.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with client stakeholders, executive sponsors, and internal leadership teams.
* Coordinate implementation activities across Product, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and other cross-functional teams.
* Partner with Product, Portfolio Management, and delivery teams to establish implementation schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking.
* Maintain visibility into implementation progress and proactively identify, communicate, and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Facilitate executive-level client meetings, steering committees, status reviews, and implementation governance sessions.
* Support launch readiness activities by coordinating operational, technical, and client readiness workstreams.
* Drive resolution of complex implementation issues through collaboration, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Maintain implementation documentation, decisions, action items, risks, and approvals throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Partner with Account Management to support client satisfaction, organizational transitions, and long-term customer success.
* Provide implementation leadership during post-launch stabilization and transition to ongoing operational support.
* Mentor and support Implementation Managers by sharing best practices, providing guidance on complex situations, and promoting consistency across the implementation organization.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, implementation standards, templates, governance practices, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide implementation status updates, portfolio insights, and risk assessments to senior leadership as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* SUCCESS MEASURESSuccessful delivery of strategic and complex client implementations.
* Early identification and mitigation of implementation risks and dependencies.
* Strong client satisfaction and stakeholder engagement.
* Consistent implementation practices across teams.
* Effective cross-functional collaboration and escalation management.
* Successful mentorship and development of implementation team members.
* High-quality launch readiness and post-launch stabilization outcomes.

Qualifications:

* (Preferred) Not provided in source content, add preferred education, experience, certifications, etc.

Pay Range: USD $111,300.11 - USD $139,125.13 /Yr.

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks like**:

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  
  
First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.  
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

jobs.title: Independent Lean Implementation Consultant (Manufacturing) – North America
jobs.description:
**Independent Lean Implementation Consultant (Manufacturing) – North America**

  

**About the work**

CCi helps manufacturers **improve performance quickly and make the gains last**.

  

Engagements often begin with a **Rapid Deployment phase**. In this phase we analyze losses and waste at site level, turn the biggest opportunities into focused improvement projects, and coach the site teams to deliver them through a clear governance cadence.

This phase also introduces the operational excellence concepts that underpin our longer-term TRACC programmes, so the site is ready to build on its early results.

  

We’re looking for **experienced, English-speaking Lean Consultants** who can lead this work on the ground, combining hands-on manufacturing expertise with the ability to coach, influence and deliver through others.

**What you’ll do**

* Coach site teams to lead their own improvement projects, building their confidence and capability in Lean, TPM and structured problem solving rather than doing the work for them.

* Carry out loss and waste analyses with the site, quantifying and costing losses in OEE, yield, waste, labour and changeovers.

* Help the site prioritize opportunities and turn them into scoped, chartered projects with clear owners, targets and timelines.

* Set up governance: project reviews, steering meetings, action tracking and benefits reporting.

* Introduce key operational excellence concepts, such as daily management, leader standard work and problem-solving routines, to prepare the site for a longer-term programme.

* Make sure benefits are validated and sustained, with standards in place before projects close.

* Engage people from operators to site leadership, so the client owns the results.

* Report progress against agreed engagement deliverables.

  

**What we’re looking for**

  

* + An outstanding **implementation consultant** who knows how to build capability and lead through others, not simply deliver the solution themselves.
  + **10+ years’ manufacturing operations experience**, including hands-on continuous improvement responsibility.
  + Industry experience, ideally within **food & beverage, chemicals, pharmaceuticals or FMCG**.
  + Strong Lean manufacturing expertise, including approaches such as **TPM, SMED, 5S, leader standard work and root cause problem solving**.
  + A strong track record of delivering improvement projects with **measurable, financially validated and sustainable results**.
  + Fluent English, with the credibility and communication skills to coach on the shop floor and engage senior management.
  + Comfortable travelling to client sites, typically **2–3 days per week**.
  + **Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification**.
  + A qualification in **Industrial, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering.**
  + Authorised to work in the country in which you are being engaged.

  

* **Nice to have**

* Even better if you bring:
  + Previous **consulting or interim transformation experience**.
  + Hands-on experience with **loss trees, cost deployment or similar loss-analysis approaches**.
  + Experience working across different manufacturing sites, environments or cultures.
  + Experience coaching teams through change and embedding new ways of working.

**What we offer**

* This is an opportunity to do more than advise. You’ll work **alongside manufacturing teams, turning improvement opportunities into measurable results**.
  + A **competitive day rate**, plus agreed expenses.
  + A **paid 4.5-day training programme** in CCi’s methodology and tools in **January 2027**.
  + Exposure to **international manufacturing clients** and real operational challenges.
  + The opportunity to continue with clients into longer-term TRACC programmes, with further training and development in the methodology
  + The opportunity to work with experienced manufacturing and operational excellence professionals while maintaining the flexibility of independent consulting.

**Working arrangement**

* **Flexibility with real on-site impact.**
  + You’ll work as an **independent contractor through your own registered business**, (registered in your applicable state, province, or jurisdiction), on a defined-deliverable basis.
  + This is a **client-facing, travel-based consulting role**, with site presence typically **2–3 days per week**, depending on the engagement.
  + Work away from the client site can be managed flexibly around engagement requirements and agreed deliverables.
  + Engagement locations will vary based on client needs, giving you the opportunity to work across different manufacturing environments.

jobs.title: RCM Implementation Consultant - EHR/SaaS/Healthcare IT/PT
jobs.description:
**About Raintree Systems**

Founded in 1983 and headquartered in Chandler, AZ, Raintree is a leading AI-powered EMR and practice management platform built specifically for physical, occupational, speech therapy, and ABA organizations. Powering millions of patient visits across thousands of locations, our award-winning, all-in-one software connects clinical, billing, and operational workflows—reducing administrative complexity and empowering therapy providers to scale with confidence and deliver superior patient care.

**Implementation Consultant – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Remote (designated states)**

**Department:** Professional Services

This position is fully remote and may be performed ideally from one of the following U.S. states: **AL, AZ, FL, GA, IN, IL, MA, MD, MI, MS, NC, OK, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WI.**

We are currently seeking an exceptional **Implementation Consultant** specializing in **Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)** to join our team and support our clients. This role is fully remote anywhere in the U.S.

The RCM Implementation Consultant will manage the implementation process for an assigned client list, working directly with clients to identify, prioritize, and manage strategic revenue cycle and clinical setup needs for an efficient and effective implementation. The RCM Implementation Consultant serves as the primary subject matter expert guiding healthcare organizations through the setup, configuration, and optimization of Raintree’s revenue cycle management, billing, and clearinghouse workflows for maximum financial efficiency.

### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversee, coordinate, and manage all aspects of the implementation for new and existing clients.
* Configure the Raintree application utilizing best practices for the latest features and functionality in the system for a given client, with specific emphasis on revenue cycle, billing, and clinical workflows.
* Analyze client billing operations, fee schedules, payer setups, and charge capture workflows to configure Raintree’s RCM module for optimal clean claim rates and reduced days in AR.
* Lead the setup, configuration, and testing of electronic claim submission, electronic remittance advice, real-time eligibility verification, and clearinghouse integrations.
* Partner with clearinghouse representatives and payer enrollment teams to ensure smooth transition and onboarding of electronic data interchange (EDI), electronic funds transfer (EFT), and ERA connections.
* Direct comprehensive end-to-end testing of clinical-to-billing handoffs—from scheduling, co-pay collection, and clinical documentation charge capture through to final claim generation and submission.
* Train client billing teams, billers, and revenue cycle managers through key product learning milestones, including claim scrubbing, denial management, patient statement processing, and financial reporting.
* Serve as a direct point of customer contact during the implementation.
* Proactively and independently manage client escalations.
* Assist in the review of client processes and the development of new workflow plans.
* Communicate progress updates weekly or as agreed upon with the client.
* Ensure implementation milestones are met on time.
* Coordinate data conversion, interface, and EDI/clearinghouse timelines and expectations.
* Follow project plans and manage scope and timeline, escalating to project managers as needed.
* Hand off to Client Support when the client has successfully completed the implementation process.
* Support sales team in hand-off of new clients.
* Assure overall client satisfaction.
* Perform other duties as needed and directed by project managers.

### **Position Proficiencies and Requirements**

* Must have experience in at least 2 of the following areas: Revenue Cycle Management / Medical Billing Software, Implementations, Product/Project Management, Training.
* Direct experience with medical billing workflows and RCM operations (charge entry, claim submission, payment posting, denial management, and AR management).
* Solid understanding of clearinghouse operations, electronic claim formats, ERAs , eligibility and claim scrubbers.
* Familiarity with therapy-specific billing requirements (PT/OT/ST), including Medicare Part B rules, modifiers, cap limits, and authorization tracking, is a strong plus.

**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

* Current Epic Certification.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote- Eligible US Locations

**About the role and about You:**

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we're hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you'll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you'll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you'll build it. When something new and complex launches, you'll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You'll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift's support team. In this role, you'll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we're maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You're organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You're comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team's needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.
* Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.
* Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.
* Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.
* Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

**What we're looking for:**

* 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.
* Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.
* Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.
* Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.
* Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.
* Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

**Bonus points:**

* A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.
* Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.
* Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.
  

*I**f Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.*

  

**For All US Based Full-Time Positions:**

The base salary for this position ranges between$56,500- $88,500. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

**How to stand out among the rest:**

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing careers@zwift.com.
